name: 58981cf5 — клавиатура в пикере свойств (+ свойство)
description: Пикер свойств массового диалога: поиск в поле не должен отбирать клавиатуру у списка — ↓ перемещает выделение, Enter выбирает. Красный на дофиксовой сборке (шаг picker-selected-after-arrow).

steps.name: seed-ontology-and-thoughts
steps.probe: (() => { const N='{{networkId}}', H='{{homeId}}'; const et=window.etn; return (async () => { const t1=await et.types.createThoughtType(N,{name:'Т1'}); const t2=await et.types.createThoughtType(N,{name:'Т2'}); const t3=await et.types.createThoughtType(N,{name:'Т3'}); const pStatus=await et.propertyRegistry.create(N,{name:'Статус',value_type:'text'}); const pOwner=await et.propertyRegistry.create(N,{name:'Ответственный',value_type:'text'}); const pPri=await et.propertyRegistry.create(N,{name:'Приоритет',value_type:'text'}); const pNote=await et.propertyRegistry.create(N,{name:'Заметка',value_type:'text'}); const pLink=await et.propertyRegistry.create(N,{name:'Прикреплено',value_type:'link',name_forward:'Прикреплено',name_reverse:'Прикреплено в'}); await et.types.createTypeProperty(N,'thought_type',t1.id,{mode:'attach',property_id:pStatus.id,required:false,position:0}); await et.types.createTypeProperty(N,'thought_type',t2.id,{mode:'attach',property_id:pOwner.id,required:false,position:0}); await et.types.createTypeProperty(N,'thought_type',t1.id,{mode:'attach',property_id:pLink.id,required:false,position:1,side:'source'}); await et.types.createTypeProperty(N,'thought_type',t2.id,{mode:'attach',property_id:pLink.id,required:false,position:1,side:'target'}); const mk=async(title,type)=>{ const r=await et.thoughts.create(N,{title,type_id:type,create_link:{direction:'parent',target_thought_id:H}}); return r.id; }; const A=await mk('A',t1.id); const B=await mk('B',t2.id); const C=await mk('C',null); const D=await mk('D',t3.id); const M=await mk('M',t2.id); const X=await mk('N',t2.id); await et.properties.set(N,'thought',A,'Статус','в работе',null); await et.properties.set(N,'thought',B,'Статус','в работе',null); await et.properties.set(N,'thought',B,'Ответственный','Иван',null); await et.properties.set(N,'thought',C,'Ответственный','Пётр',null); await et.properties.set(N,'thought',A,'Прикреплено',[M],'source'); window.__bulk={note:pNote.id,t1:t1.id,t2:t2.id,t3:t3.id,status:pStatus.id,owner:pOwner.id,pri:pPri.id,link:pLink.id,A:A,B:B,C:C,D:D,M:M,N:X}; return 'ok'; })(); })()

steps.name: seeded-thoughts-on-canvas
steps.waitFor: (() => { const b=window.__bulk; return b !== undefined && [b.A,b.B,b.C,b.D,b.M,b.N].every((id)=>document.querySelector('.cloud[data-id="'+id+'"]') !== null); })()

steps.name: select-a-b-c
steps.probe: (() => { const click=(id)=>{ const el=document.querySelector('.cloud[data-id="'+id+'"]'); if(el===null) return false; el.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click',{bubbles:true,cancelable:true,ctrlKey:true})); return true; }; const b=window.__bulk; return { A:click(b.A), B:click(b.B), C:click(b.C) }; })()

steps.name: step1-open-property-values-dialog
steps.probe: (() => { const item=[...document.querySelectorAll('.menu .menu-item')].find((m)=>m.textContent.includes('Изменить значение свойства')); if(!item) return 'no-item'; item.click(); return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: picker-selected-after-arrow
steps.probe: (() => { const grid=document.querySelector('.property-list vaadin-grid'); return { activeName: grid && grid.activeItem ? grid.activeItem.name : null }; })()

steps.name: picker-closed-and-row-checked
steps.waitFor: (() => { const cb=document.querySelector('input[type=checkbox][aria-label="Приоритет"]'); return document.querySelector('.property-list vaadin-grid')===null && cb!==null && cb.checked===true; })()

steps.name: picker-active-is-table
steps.probe: (() => { const a=document.activeElement; return { isTable: !!(a && a.classList && a.classList.contains('ui-table')) }; })()

steps.name: picker-second-row-checked
steps.waitFor: (() => { const boxes=[...document.querySelectorAll('.prop-bulk-table input[type=checkbox]')]; return document.querySelector('.property-list vaadin-grid')===null && boxes.length===5 && boxes.some((b)=>b.checked); })()
